body:
REVIEW FINDING, 2026-09-04, from the T263 PR 8a review chain (round eight). The operator's federation road can make a container that no page of the person's can ever show, re-shape, or drop.

THE SHAPE. `openChannel`'s unbound branch declares the container it receives into, plus every undeclared level between it and the nearest standing name. A parent edge is written only where a parent stands, so when the top-level name does not stand, the topmost new level is declared with NO parent edge. `loam_federate_connect --into zed:room:leaf` on a store with no `zed` mints `zed:room` with no edge and `zed:room:leaf` under it. Nothing dangles. But reach — `subtreeOf`, which the admin page and the consent page walk — starts at the person's home and follows parent and inboxOf edges, so a parentless `zed:room` is in no walk. Provision `zed` afterwards and `subtreeOf(table, "zed")` is exactly `["zed"]` while a live channel holds a peer's bytes in `zed:room:leaf`.

WHY IT WAS NOT FIXED IN THAT PR, AND WHICH RAIL ACTUALLY BLOCKS IT. Three repairs, three frozen rails:
- Refusing the target when its top-level name does not stand breaks `test/federation/channel-open.test.ts`, which opens a channel into `friends` on a store that has no `friends`.
- Minting the colon-free ancestor breaks `test/federation/prefix-collision.test.ts:688`, which asserts that opening into `ada:feed` does NOT declare `ada`.
- Refusing only the DEEP case — where the topmost new level is not the target itself — breaks `test/federation/prefix-collision.test.ts:164`, which opens into `one:deep:nest` on a store where `one` does not stand, and depends on this road minting the parentless `one:deep`. That is the same depth-3 shape this ticket describes, already frozen.
The third is the repair a reader will reach for first, and it is the one the review round originally mis-cited. All three files are frozen rails of archived tickets, so the shape is a landed decision and changing it is a decision, not a repair.

A SECOND HALF, SAME ROOT. Because such a container exists and has no parent edge, `loam_container_declare` and `loam_container_leeway` refuse to work beneath it — they ask `subtreeUnder`, which agrees with `subtreeOf`. The person is told its edges do not lead back to their container, and there is no road that repairs the edge: the admin declare door refuses a name that already stands, and no migration backfills a parent. The capability loss is silent and correct; the road out is missing.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) A container this road makes is reachable from the person's own home by the walk their pages use, at every depth, or the act is refused before anything is written. Verify: a case in test/federation/ that opens a channel into a three-level name on a store where the top level does not stand, then asserts `subtreeOf` from that top level reaches the container holding the pool.
(b) The two landed decisions are either kept or changed deliberately, and the change is stated: opening into a colon-free name that does not stand still works, and opening into `a:b` still does not mint `a` — or a new decision replaces one of them, in the spec, with Myk's word. Verify: test/federation/channel-open.test.ts and test/federation/prefix-collision.test.ts, unchanged and green, or a spec section recording the new position.
(c) A container already at rest with no parent edge has a road back into the person's reach. Verify: a case driving that road end to end, two-sided — the container becomes reachable, and a container in another person's subtree is not.

Merge tier: (a) and (c) are repairs. (b) may need Myk's sentence, because it can change what a landed rail decided.
title: The operator's federation road can make an unreachable container
